EXPERIMENTAL SYSTEMS
OBSERVATION · INTENTION · DESIGN
01 / THE SUBJECT

Alchemy is a connected body of work in intelligence, perception, communication, secure protocols and distributed software. Rasen Falcon is where that work becomes accessible.

01 / 03

A different kind of software architecture

Alchemy brings together independently usable services: each has a defined responsibility, a language-neutral boundary where appropriate, and an explicit account of state and authority. The purpose is composition without forcing every application through a single framework.

  • Services before monoliths
  • Evidence before assertion
  • Authority before automation
  • Portability by design
02 / 03

Perception, made useful

Signals, sound, image, moving pictures and three-dimensional worlds are different media, but the questions we ask of them often have the same structure: what is present, what changed, and what can we support with evidence?

  • Audio pattern discovery
  • Video and visual understanding
  • Visualisation and exploration
  • Human and machine interpretation
03 / 03

Intelligence with boundaries

An intelligent system should distinguish an intention from an instruction, a suggestion from an authorised action, and a plausible answer from a verified fact. That distinction runs through the Alchemy work.

  • Intention-aware services
  • Auditable decisions
  • Explicit policy boundaries
  • Human-directed outcomes
“
Intelligence is more useful when it can explain what it knows, what it intends, and what it is permitted to do.
